purpose: Concrete readout-definition proposal; no A2/B calibration or native rerun

placement.center_evaluation: continuous physical/material centre; no mesh snapping

active_field: Native Holmes 3 active Rac concentration, first native state field
amount_units: Native concentration times native arc length; no absolute molecule-count calibration

handover_saved_bracket_evidence.resolution: Saved native fields bracket the event; no interpolated event time is asserted

proposed_rule: Two resolved peaks: continuous local-parabolic subcell saddle boundaries define each basin; integrate the actual native piecewise-linear profile above the common instantaneous minimum. Sum partitions all active excess. Handover is challenger excess first exceeding incumbent excess while two peaks remain resolved.
ambiguity_rule: One moving/merged region, extra peaks, ambiguous site association or low contrast get explicit separate outcomes; do not invent a continuous two-region handover or eligible B seed.
approval_authority: User: yes obviously you should not restrict challenger activity counting to the area under the cue.

proposed_complete_region_readout.convention: Complete excess in two periodic watersheds above common current minimum; continuous subcell-parabolic saddle boundaries, piecewise-linear fractional integration

whole_field_diagnostic.convention: Complete-field circular Voronoi halves around initial incumbent and cue axes, no beam-footprint ROI; diagnostic only

proposed_complete_region_readout.note: One-region relocation/merger is not a two-region excess handover
proposed_complete_region_readout.allocation_note: One complete region assigned by spatial proximity only; a change of this label is a relocation/merger event, not a continuous two-region handover
